values.note: DCNR state forest motorized campsite rate (a state forest program, not a state park one). The $6.50 reservation fee is non-refundable and charged once per booking.

fees.source: ReserveAmerica price block on the dated site page(s) (read 2026-11-10): 'Residents of PA $10.00 Per Night, $70.00 Per Week', 'Non-Residents $15.00 Per Night, $105.00 Per Week', 'Reservation Fees $6.50'. https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/overnight-prices-and-policies ('Motorized roadside, hike-in roadside, equestrian, and rustic campsites can be reserved for a fee of $10.00 a night for Pennsylvania residents and $15.00 a night for non-residents')

values.note: Check-in and check-out are 3 pm. After a stay, 48 hours off state forest land before camping again.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/loyalsock/camping ('may be reserved up to eleven months in advance'; 'Stays are limited to seven nights'; 'Check in and check out time is 3:00 P.M. note: A short gravel back-in (about 20 ft) in the woods beside Shanerburg Road, partly shaded, about 2.5 miles from Worlds End Road; the agency also gives a way in by Mineral Spring Road from PA 154. The agency's campsite map layer marks the site as having no trailer access (one vehicle, tent or small trailer/RV), while the booking page sells it as an RV and trailer site and adds that it was not designed for RVs; it is listed as 50 by 27 ft with 16 ft of overhead clearance. No toilet. Pack out trash. --Claude
